Carriers of the Cross / The guild guide

Servant Leadership

Leaders exist to serve the community, not to be served by it.

Our GuildOur CharterGuild LifeStatement of FaithCommunity RulesMembershipLeadershipGuild Ranks

Character before authority

A leader’s success should be measured by the health of the community, not their rank or authority.

CotC leaders should demonstrate:

  • Humility: putting the needs of others ahead of personal recognition.
  • Commitment: believing in and actively supporting the guild’s mission.
  • Emotional maturity: listening well, handling conflict wisely, and treating people with grace.
  • Biblical maturity: demonstrating a growing relationship with Christ and sound biblical judgment.
  • Active participation: playing alongside members, building relationships, and sometimes setting aside personal gameplay goals to serve others.

Protecting the community

Moderators help protect guild chat and Discord. Officers participate in leadership meetings and decisions, helping shape the guild’s future. The Guild Master serves as tie breaker.

Spiritual and organizational leaders are expected to be Christians with biblical maturity. Moderator requirements include sharing a testimony with the Officers and affirming the Statement of Faith.

Questions or concerns?

Reach out to an Officer in-game or through Discord. Please handle personal concerns privately and treat information shared in confidence with care.
